response.summary: When a vendor bills in US dollars, a 3% buffer is added to the converted INR price to account for exchange‑rate movement. This buffered amount is used for budget and approval checks, along with GST.

request.item: buffer added when a vendor bills in US dollars

reasons.statement: Convert the price to INR at the current market rate on the day of the request, then add a 3% buffer for exchange-rate movement.

sources.title: Foreign Currency Purchases
sources.text:
Convert the price to INR at the current market rate on the day of the request, then add
a 3% buffer for exchange-rate movement. Budget and approval checks use this buffered
amount plus GST.
